Software Engineer I – Lustre File System Development
Location - Pune, India
Full Time Employment

About DDN
DDN (DataDirect Networks) is a global leader in AI and data intelligence solutions, powering many of the world’s largest AI, HPC, cloud, and enterprise environments. Our cutting-edge storage technologies enable organizations to accelerate innovation through high-performance data infrastructure.
As a member of the Lustre Engineering team, you will work on one of the world’s most widely deployed parallel file systems, contributing to technologies that power large-scale AI, machine learning, scientific computing, and high-performance computing environments.

Role Overview
We are looking for highly motivated Software Engineering Interns to join our Lustre File System Development team. This internship provides an opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers on the development, enhancement, testing, and performance optimization of distributed storage and parallel file system technologies.
The ideal candidate should have strong fundamentals in Computer Science, operating systems, data structures, algorithms, and Linux programming, along with a passion for systems software development.

Key Responsibilities
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of Lustre distributed file system features.
• Assist in designing, coding, debugging, and testing kernel and user-space components.
• Develop automation tools and scripts for testing and validation.
• Analyze performance bottlenecks and participate in optimization initiatives.
• Work on bug fixing, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
• Collaborate with senior engineers on feature development and code reviews.
• Participate in engineering discussions, sprint planning, and technical reviews.
• Create and maintain technical documentation.

Required Skills
Technical Skills
• Strong knowledge of C programming.
• Good understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms.
• Strong understanding of Operating System concepts:
o Processes and Threads
o Memory Management
o File Systems
o Synchronization and Concurrency
• Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments.
• Understanding of Computer Networks fundamentals.
• Knowledge of Git version control.

Preferred Skills
• Exposure to Linux Kernel internals.
• Knowledge of Distributed Systems concepts.
• Familiarity with Storage Technologies.
• Experience with Python, Shell Scripting, or automation frameworks.
• Understanding of Parallel File Systems or High-Performance Computing environments.

Educational Qualifications
• Pursuing B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in:
o Computer Science Engineering
o Information Technology
o Electronics & Communication
o Related Engineering Disciplines
• Strong academic record.

What You’ll Gain
• Hands-on experience working on enterprise-scale distributed storage systems.
• Exposure to Lustre Parallel File System and advanced storage technologies.
• Mentorship from industry-leading storage engineers.
• Experience with large-scale software development practices.
• Opportunity to contribute to products used by leading AI, HPC, and enterprise customers worldwide.

Preferred Candidate Profile
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Passion for systems software and low-level programming.
• Ability to learn quickly and work in a collaborative environment.
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
• Self-driven attitude with attention to detail.
 
Join DDN and help build the next generation of high-performance storage solutions powering AI and data-intensive workloads around the globe.
